title: Stakeholder breadth and coverage / multithreading

har97_refs.text: ## 5.4 Stakeholder breadth — too many people added?

questions.text: Is the action involving more people than the situation requires?
Does the opportunity have the right stakeholder coverage for its stage and complexity?

criteria.guide: Does the deal (or this step) hang on one contact although the stage needs more?
Are roles the customer's process needs (e.g. security, economic buyer) missing from coverage?
Are the people involved the ones this step and stage need, no more and no fewer?
Are senior or unrelated people pulled in before the working-level step needs them?

criteria.text: stakeholder concentration around only one contact
criteria.guide: Is all engagement concentrated on one contact while others are known and relevant?

har97.text: * stakeholder concentration around only one contact

failure_examples: CCing the entire buying group on a narrow technical follow-up
turning a one-to-one relationship repair into a broad thread
adding every known stakeholder because the graph knows they exist
counter_failures: too few people when multithreading is actually necessary
principles: This replaces simplistic “more stakeholders is better.” (§15(GTM).3)
Separate from stakeholder selection: judge breadth, not whether each person is the right one.

labels.label: UNDER_THREADED
labels.when: The action involves fewer people than this step requires (§5.4).

labels.label: RIGHT_SIZED
labels.when: The people involved fit the step and the deal's stage.

labels.label: OVER_THREADED
labels.when: The action involves more people than this step requires (§5.4).

labels.label: SINGLE_THREADED_RISK
labels.when: The deal's coverage hangs on one contact for its stage (§15(GTM).3).

labels.label: OVER_THREADED_TOO_EARLY
labels.when: The deal pulls in senior or broad coverage before its stage needs it (§15(GTM).3).

diagnostics.name: single_threaded
diagnostics.when: the deal or step depends on one contact

diagnostics.name: under_threaded
diagnostics.when: fewer people than the step needs

diagnostics.name: over_threaded_too_early
diagnostics.when: senior or broad involvement before the stage needs it

diagnostics.name: wrong_stakeholder
diagnostics.when: breadth is right but a slot is filled by the wrong person
